title: Split the application into conflict-safe feature modules
summary: Extract recorder, transcript, notes, storage, and assistant boundaries from the App.tsx monolith without changing user behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Recorder, transcript, notes, assistant, and course workflows have explicit module boundaries.
UI and runtime work no longer require routine edits to the same orchestration file.
Existing recording and playback behavior passes regression checks.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
